violations.description: Thawing potentially hazardous food. — --Potentially hazardous food was not thawed in an approved manner. -Several bags of potatoes open air thawing in prep sink. *Directed to place 3 bags in refrigerator and to leave one in prep sink with cold running water.

Cooling of potentially hazardous food. — --Cooling of potentially hazardous food was not accomplished using proper methods. -Chicken broth soup stated as placed into refrigerator at ~12p.m. Found at 1:40 tightly covered with temperature of 89F. *Redirected immediately to actively cool with ice. COS to less than 70F at ~2p.m.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Could not find date mark for Green Goddess. -Tartar sauce portions stated as made last Friday were not date marked.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Salsa made in-house had date of 10/15.

Time as a public health control. — --Food was not marked or identified with the time within which it must be cooked, served, or discarded. -Garlic butter (Liquid butter and refrigerated minced garlic) not marked for hold time and left at room temperature.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. -Several employee drinks/items stored on top of chest freezer in mop closet. -Purse and sweater stored on corner of storage rack near soup station. -Personal drink stored on shelf with clean glasses at bar.

General premises. — --Perimeter walls and roof did not effectively protect establishment from the weather and entry of insects, rodents, and other animals. -Back/kitchen door magnetic screen has some gapping at bottom.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. -Ice bathed beef and pasta up to 50F at top of container (fine at bottom layer). -FOH single door cooler used for condiments found with food temperatures at 53F. *Directed to dispose of dairy and house made condiments found over 50F in FOH single door fridge. -Found chicken enchilada soup from yesterday's service in to-Go cooler with temperature of 47F. *Could not determine if issue was from cooling, packaging or holding. Recommended disposal.

Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. -Open display case 46F at back to 55F in salsa. -Ambient temperature at front single door 47. -2 door glass sour cream 61F. -Single door (tea) ambient 52F, sauce 50F. -Make table top 42F-45F, bottom 42F. -Small sauce refrigerator Queso 45F, alfredo 43, bottom butter 40. *Facility has a morning and evening temp log that showed good opening and closing temperatures-all under 41F. The open face display appeared to be in defrost at time of arrival. Facility also had a busy lunch and stocked multiple items today. ***Left with instructions to cool products ASAP and monitor units for recovery.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. -Asian sauce not date marked.--Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food was not consumed/discarded within 10 calendar days from the date of preparation. -Seasoned/scampi butter dated 4/24.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. -Residue at oven handle. -Debris at interior of table top air fryer/oven.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. -Quat test strips on available for testing sani buckets.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. -Sani bucket filled at bar hand sink. *Corrected on-site, redirected staff to fill at bar prep sink.
